integrity: The proof is analytic; CHECK.py performs finite, independent numerical diagnostics rather than a formal or exhaustive certification.
scientific_limitations: Fixed regular immersed spherical curves with exactly one unordered antipodal parameter pair, parallel tangents and nonzero half-sum curvature vector; no claim for general nonspherical curves, multiple diametral pairs or vanishing quadratic contact. Classical Viviani geometry and arclength are credited. Novelty priority provisional.
title: Quartic antipodal tangency and the three-quarter chord tail of Viviani's curve
